title: Nippy Crispy Chinese Shrimp Stew
description: A salty, crispy quick-fix Chinese stew featuring miso-marinated shrimp and Asian chives in a low-calorie tagine.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk shrimp with miso paste, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil until coated.
Heat vegetable oil in a ceramic tagine over medium-high heat, then add shrimp and sear until pink, about 2 minutes.
Add minced garlic and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth, bring to a gentle simmer, and let it reduce for 3 minutes.
Mix cornstarch slurry into the stew and stir until slightly thickened, about 1 minute.
Fold in sliced Asian chives and cook for another 2 minutes until wilted.
Taste and adjust seasoning with a pinch of white pepper if desired.
Serve hot directly from the tagine.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
